_comment: One file per test case. Copy this as a template once the pilot process is chosen and you know its real trigger and expected output.

trigger._comment: How the deployed-to-Dev process gets invoked for this test. If it's not an HTTP listener, run_tests.py's trigger logic needs a matching branch.

expected._comment: What run_tests.py checks the Execution Record against once the run finishes.
